snippet.title: Super Penguin Ball & Chain Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Super Penguin Ball & Chain is a marble rolling game where you're chained to your friends! Play solo or with friends, and roll your way to the end of each level!

Try out the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3593730/Super_Penguin_Ball__Chain_Demo/
